title: PH updates maritime chart of Pag-asa Island, set for UN submission
summary: The Philippine National Maritime Council on Friday unveiled an updated maritime chart showing the high-tide features of Pag-asa Island, Lawak Island and other features in the Kalayaan Island Group.
